name: deep-mechanism-investigation
description: A sustained PMP22 investigation with executed analysis, a persistent queue, and an auditable stopping boundary. A continuation is not a controlled comparison with the original trial.

cases.question: What is the full regulatory system for PMP22?
cases.investigation_brief: Pursue the unexplained Egr2-AS RNA discrepancy in the available work, seek quantitative accessibility measurements, and acquire and analyze suitable measurements for an underexplored RNA or protein-regulation branch. Audit sample mapping and assay endpoints before formal inference. Use broader data-driven exploration where the design supports it, not only a preselected gene panel. These are investigation priorities, not assertions that suitable data exist or that a particular mechanism is true. Seek independent experiments when useful. Preserve exact primary-source text and measurement bytes needed to review consequential claims. Continue into the most consequential feasible unresolved item; use specific evidence for blockers and retain the remaining frontier.
review_focus: Assess all six mechanism dimensions against newly performed work; inherited outputs and a larger resource budget are not evidence of improvement.

Verify each analyzed high-priority queue item against exact measurement files, executed code, outputs and derivation. Do not mistake a successful registration or command substring for execution proof.
Distinguish attempted acquisition, successful measurement acquisition, metadata inspection, executed analysis, contextual evidence and causal discrimination.

Audit broader data-driven exploration and follow-up on unexpected results, including any revisited sample mapping, quantitative accessibility or RNA/protein branch. Do not require an invented statistical result when the design is insufficient.
Examine whether feasible consequential work remained at stopping, whether blocked items have real evidence, and whether decisions/checkpoints preceded the follow-up they motivated.
Require preserved source support for consequential claims. Source existence, an accession or an excerpt alone cannot establish an uninspected mechanism.
